sloka: ते माम् भवन्तः सिद्धि अर्थम् याजयंतु समाहिताः ।स शरीरो यथा अहम् वै देव लोकम् अवाप्नुयाम् ॥१-५७-२०॥
transliteration: te mām bhavantaḥ siddhi artham yājayaṁtu samāhitāḥ ।sa śarīro yathā aham vai deva lokam avāpnuyām ॥1-57-20॥

translations.english: I have performed various sacirifices and ruled over my people guided by the law of righteousness. I have pleased eminent elders with my conduct and character.
